title: Webhook Signature Security, Rate Limiter & Event Deduplication Middleware Review Package
author: Antigravity & Codex

overview.goal: Protect inbound webhooks and widget ingestion against replay attacks, duplicate delivery spikes, and flood attempts
overview.summary: Implemented HMAC-SHA256 signature verification for Meta and Zalo payloads, thread-safe token-bucket rate limiter per IP / workspace, and SQLite-backed activity log deduplication for inbound webhook events within a 10-minute sliding window.
